items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: You and I were at a dinner table with Bucky and Ruth. And it’s like you just take after them, hanging out together, having a good time together.

ctx.x: Is it hard with all the traveling and so forth and the way your life is, is it hard to have a established relationships?

Yes. I think every musician is going to say yes to this. If they so no, not really, then they’ve just got really lucky. I mean really. Because you see the wonderful relationships. You and I were at a dinner table with Bucky and Ruth. And it’s like you just take after them, hanging out together, having a good time together. It’s wonderful. It’s so wonderful to see but it’s also so rare. So yes, right now I’m single. I was married. But I have a wonderful guy in my life so I would definitely tie the knot again. It’s…
You have to go where the work is.
